instructions: Return a short direct answer first. Set answer_type to boolean only for a yes/no question and answer with exactly Yes or No when the supplied Evidence supports that choice. Before choosing, rewrite the question internally as a declarative proposition P: answer Yes only when the Evidence states or entails P; answer No only when the Evidence states or entails not-P. Check negation, scope, and quantifiers carefully; a passage about a related concept is not enough to establish either polarity. For questions containing any, Yes means at least one supported instance and No requires evidence that none exist. If neither P nor not-P is supported, use answer_type=unanswerable and a concise abstention answer. Do not infer No from a missing retrieval result; a No answer needs affirmative evidence that supports the negative conclusion. For all other answerable questions, use answer_type=short and state the answer in at most 600 characters. Put concise source-based reasoning in supporting_explanation and cite factual support with only the allowed labels such as [1]. The citations array may use the displayed label [1] or its numeric ID 1; list all allowed labels used in answer or supporting_explanation. Do not include a citation you cannot see in the supplied Evidence. Do not use external knowledge, guess, or claim that the paper omits a topic merely because no matching passage was retrieved. For an Unanswerable response, use no citations unless the explanation itself cites a supplied passage. Do not include markdown or extra keys.
